subject: IAM evidence playbook + questionnaire initiation for MediPoint
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@medipoint.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: IAM evidence playbook + questionnaire initiation for MediPoint

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same view: 

Summary
- Scope: vendor security intake focused on Identity & Access (SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, RBAC, admin controls) plus SOC 2 attestation and GDPR/HIPAA posture.
- Objective: collect the evidence Redwood needs to complete our standard onboarding and security review so we can move the account to a Dedicated capacity proposal.

Immediate asks for your team
1) SOC 2: PDF of the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (redactions accepted) and a current SOC 2 scope statement.
2) SSO: IdP metadata (SAML metadata XML) and confirmation of the IdP vendor (Okta/Azure/Other).
3) SCIM: sample provisioning logs (successful push events) and whether SCIM is configured as push or pull.
4) RBAC/admin: screenshot of admin roles mapping (who can invite/manage orgs) and a short note on delegated admin controls.
5) Questionnaire: please start the attached vendor security questionnaire (we marked the IAM-focused tabs first).

Timeline
- If you can share the items above by EOD next Wednesday (2026-09-22) we should be able to complete the first-pass review and follow with a technical verification call the following week.

Attachments referenced
- sso-scim-evidence-template.xlsx (attached) — a quick intake template for the IdP/SCIM/RBAC artifacts.
- vendor-security-questionnaire.pdf (attached) — standard questionnaire, please focus on Sections 2–4 for now.

If anything on that list is not feasible, please flag it and we’ll reprioritize. I’ll loop in Ben and Marissa to manage the mapping and technical follow-up.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: IAM evidence playbook + questionnaire initiation for MediPoint

Laura + Sara — quick follow-up from my side with a few clarifying items so we can reduce back-and-forth during evidence collection: 

1) IdP vendor
- Can you confirm whether you’re using Okta or Azure AD as the primary IdP? If you have a custom SAML implementation, please indicate that so we can tailor the metadata checklist (certificate expiration, entityID, ACS URL).

2) SCIM provisioning
- If SCIM is push-based, the provisioning logs we need are the successful POST responses and a sample 200 OK for a user create. If pull-based, give us the last full sync timestamp and any error snippets.

3) RBAC screenshots
- We generally ask for the admin role list + a mapping to least-privilege roles (example: "Org Admin -> Can manage billing and invites", "Support Agent -> Support-only access"). A short CSV exported from your admin UI works fine.

4) Control mapping
- I’ve attached a lightweight mapping sheet (same workbook Laura attached). Ben will own mapping the items to SOC 2 sections on our side; Marissa will handle technical validation.

If it helps, we can take the first pass and fill the mapping columns from the documents you send — that saves you time. Happy to jump on a 30-minute tech call if your security engineer prefers to walk through the logs live.

Thanks,
Ben
Enterprise Security & Sales Engineering
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachment(s): idp-scim-intake-sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)
